description: UI projection of the per-item lifecycle inside a campaign. Re-targeted from the conflict-resolution flow (features/conflicts/flow): same CampaignItemStatus states, but the events are the ones the campaign TRACKER drives — resolve/apply mark an item fixed, and a re-audit reconciles by stable id (absent→validate, reappeared-terminal→regress). Mirrors api/internal/campaign/service.go (ResolveItem / ReauditCampaign). transition.ts is the runtime authority; flow.test.ts replays this declaration to guarantee they agree. Adding a state or transition requires updating service.go, this JSON, transition.ts, and flow.test.ts together.

states.description: Item was ingested (or regressed back) and awaits work.
Mirrored from the conflict lifecycle; the campaign tracker treats it as open (the tracker has no assign step, but the state is accepted from the wire).
Mirrored from the conflict lifecycle; treated as open.
Agent marked the item fixed by hand (resolve/apply); awaits a re-audit to confirm.
A re-audit no longer saw the item — the fix held (terminal-good).
Defensive sink mirrored from the conflict lifecycle; the campaign domain never produces it.
Defensive sink mirrored from the conflict lifecycle; the campaign domain never produces it.

events.description: Agent calls ResolveItem with a note.
A re-audit found the item absent → the fix held.
A re-audit saw a terminal item reappear (or a brand-new item) → back to detected, flagged regressed.
Operator closes the whole campaign (does not change an item's status).

invariants.description: No event moves an item out of 'committed'.
No event moves an item out of 'force_resolved'.
'regress' from any non-sink state returns to 'detected'.
'close' never changes an item's status (it closes the campaign, not the item).
